  1. Job letters

Terms of use

By using this service you agree to these terms. We may update them — when we do, the date below will change.

Last updated: alpha release

Who can use this service

This service is for current employees of the Ministry of Education Transformation. It generates a job letter from the records the Ministry holds about you.

What you must not do

  • Request a letter for somebody other than yourself.
  • Alter the contents of a letter after it has been issued. The QR code on each letter is checked when scanned; tampered letters fail verification.
  • Use the service to attempt to access systems or data you are not entitled to.

Reliance on letters

Banks, retailers and other parties relying on a letter should scan the QR code or visit the verification link printed on the letter. The page shows what the Ministry's record said on the day the letter was issued, so you can compare it against the letter you were given.
